reason: B is preferable because it includes the crucial composition-controlled comparison between Co-free FeNiCrMn and CoCrFeMnNi under identical temperature and strain-rate conditions, whereas A attributes an effect to Co removal without directly testing it. Both remain weakly decisive and largely extend a mechanism already proposed for the Co-containing alloy, but A also makes less physically secure claims about stronger solute pinning at low temperature and phonon drag at elevated temperature.
